issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Milkable.messageOnMilk(): the problem statement UML and textual description declare a no-argument method messageOnMilk() returning a String (e.g., "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"), and the template Main() calls m.messageOnMilk() with no arguments. The solution, however, declares Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) and implements messageOnMilk(double) in Seal and Goat. This parameter mismatch (no-arg vs. one double parameter) will cause confusion and compilation/usage incompatibility for students following the problem statement and template.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Preferred: change the solution to match the problem statement by declaring String messageOnMilk() in Milkable and implement the no-arg messageOnMilk() in Seal and Goat returning the specified text (e.g., "Seal Clarabelle is milked"). Alternatively, if the volume parameter is intended, update the problem statement UML, the textual description, and the template Main() to document and call messageOnMilk(double) consistently (and update example return-value text to include volume).
